tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// nor lha g.yang skyabs bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ rat+na a pa rā dzi ta ya na ma// bod skad du/ nor la g.yang skyabs zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus cig na/ sngon lha'i yul na lha'i bu nor bu lha zhes bya ba yod de/ dkor nor gyi phung po dpag tu med pa yod pa las/ dus nam zhig tsam na dkor nor rnams kyang 'thor/ bang mdzod rnams kyang stong*/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ kyai/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa lha yi lha/ bdag gi dkor nor 'thor ba dang*/ bang mdzod stong par gyur pa'i lan don cis byas/ thabs kyi rgyal po ci zhig mnga'/ de skad ces zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// lan don dkor nor g.yang skor la// de yi dgos thabs ngas bshad kyis// legs par nyon la yid la zungs// de skad ces bka' bstsal to// de nas rgyu skar bzang po la// byugs po rgyal po gang 'byor// 'bru sna lnga dang sman sna lnga/ bza' ba btung ba'i tshogs gang 'dzoms// zho dang 'o ma chang mngar gsum sha mar bdud rtsi bcas rang nyid shākya thub par bsgom/ lag tu mda' mo bya rgod can la/ dar dkar me long g.yung chung brtags la g.yab bo// hūṃ/ chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// chos rnams kun la mnga' mdzad dbang gyur pa// nor rnams rgyas shing 'phel mdzad pa'i// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs shes pa'i// me long g.yang rten mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yang*// zhal zas tshogs rnams kun la mnga' mdzad dbang gyur pa'i// zhal zas tshogs rnams rgyas shing 'phel mdzad pa'i// zho yi g.yang rten mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// deng 'dir bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyug g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/

klu yi rgyal por char sprin wa ru na// me tog kun la mnga' mdzad dbang 'gyur pa'i// lo tog sna dgu rgyas shing 'phel mdzad pa'i/ nas kyi g.yang rten mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ phyugs lha'i rgyal po dgra lha rab brtan yang*/ phyugs kyi lha rnams kun la mnga' mdzad dbang gyur pa'i// phyugs zas tshogs rnams rgyas shing 'phel mdzad pa'i// mar gyi g.yang rten mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūm̐/ nor lha'i rgyal po ār+ya dzam bha la/ nor rnams kun la mnga' mdzad dbang gyur pa'i// dkor nor sna dgu rgyas shing 'phel mdzad pa'i// rin chen sna lnga mi 'gyur rdo rje rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ nor rgyun lha mo nor rnams kun gyi bdag /dgos 'dod sna dgu 'byung zhing nor rnams kun gyi gtso// rin chen sna bdun mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rten// dar dkar g.yab cing slad nas spyan 'dren no// de ring bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ nor rnams sa ltar mi 'gyur brtan pa dang*// shing ltar rags shing rgyas pa dang*// me ltar gsal shing 'bar ba dang*// lcags ltar ba sra zhing mkhregs pa dang*// chu ltar rgyun du ring ba dang*// 'byung ba'i g.yang rnams 'dir byon cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/

phywa g.yang dgung sngon bzhin du mtho ba dang*/ nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// 'ja' tshon bzhin du bkrag mdangs dang*// gza' skar bzhin du rags pa dang*// lho sprin bzhin du 'thibs pa dang*// ri rab bzhin du brtan pa dang*// sa gzhi bzhin du snyoms pa dang*// 'byung ba'i g.yang rnams 'dir byon cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ lha yi rgyal po lha chen khyung dkar ni// mi yi g.yang bsdus tshogs rar slan/ nas kyi g.yang bsdus 'du bar slan// lug gi g.yang bsdus gyang rar slan// phyugs kyi g.yang bsdus ra bar slan// zas kyi g.yang bsdus sgo khar slan// gos kyi g.yang bsdus gdang la slan// chang gi g.yang bsdus bum par slan// zhing gi g.yang bsdus mu la slan// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ dar ba btsan gyi dgra lha/ phyugs dmangs kyi mang g.yang*/ rta stong*/ nag 'bum/ lug bye ba/ nas kyi bang mdzod/ gser gyi gter sgo/ g.yu'i bang mdzod/ gtso bor jo bo dkon mchog gsum po'i phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir byon// bkra shis thams cad 'dir byon cig /bde legs thams cad 'dir byon cig /bsod nams thams cad 'dir byon cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ kun tu bzang po'i byin rlabs dang*// spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs dang*// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i shes rab dang*// bla ma dkon mchog gsum po'i byin rlabs kyis// mi 'gyur g.yang 'di rab tu brtan gyur cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūm̐/ shar gyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa/ nyi zla bzhin du shar bzhin byon// hūṃ/ lho yi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lho sprin bzhin du 'thibs bzhin byon// hūm̐/

nub kyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa// chu bo bzhin du 'bab bzhin byon// hūṃ/ byang gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa// skyi bser bzhin du 'grims bzhin byon// hūm̐/ steng gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa// sbrang char bzhin du 'bab bzhin byon// hūṃ/ 'og gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lo tog bzhin du smin bzhin byon// khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūm̐/ 'byung ba shing ni dar ba dang*// de bzhin me ni dar ba yin// me dar de ni sa dar ro// sa dar de ni lcags dar ro// lcags dar de ni chu dar ro// chu dar de ni shing dar ro// 'byung ba de bzhin dar ba na// mi g.yang de bzhin dar gyur cig /'byung ba de bzhin bkra shis na// mi g.yang de bzhin bkra shis shog /'byung ba de bzhin 'phel ba na// mi g.yang de bzhin 'phel bar shog /nor g.yang khyim du lon par shog /zhing g.yang mu la lon par shog /nas g.yang bang mdzod lon par shog /gos g.yang gdang la lon par shog /chang g.yang ban du lon par shog /zas g.yang sgo khar lon par shog /phyugs g.yang ra bar lon par shog /mi g.yang khyim du lon par shog /mngal du bu mo bu phor 'gyur// mi zas rnams la bdud rtsi'i char phob cig /sa la bdud rtsi'i ljang bu 'khrungs par shog /hūṃ/ mgo nag mi yi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma mgo la lon// nyams yang skar ma mgo la nyams// mgo nag mi yi phywa khug la// mgo nag mi yi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ byol song phyugs kyi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma be'u dag la lon// nyams yang skar ma be'u dag la nyams// byol song phyugs kyi phywa khug la// byol song phyugs kyi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/

g.yang dkar lug gi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma rgyal la lon// nyams yang skar ma rgyal la nyams// g.yang dkar lug gi phywa khug la// g.yang dkar lug gi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ tshe tshe ra yi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma bya rog sgo nga dag la lon// nyams yang skar ma bya rog sgo nga dag la nyams// tshe tshe ra yi phywa khug la// tshe tshe ra yi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūm̐/ klu mo zhing gi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma sa ri dag la lon// nyams yang skar ma sa ri dag la nyams// klu mo zhing gi phywa khug la// klu mo zhing gi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye sa hūṃ// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūm̐/ gru gu rta dang bong bu'i g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma gro la lon// nyams yang skar ma gro la nyams// gru gu rta dang bong bu'i phywa khug la// gru gu rta dang bong bu'i g.yang skyobs shig /khu yepuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ dkar mo nas kyi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma bre phul dag la lon// nyams yang skar ma bre phul dag la nyams// dkar mo nas kyi phywa khug la// dkar mo nas kyi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ ser mo chang gi phya dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma sbrum la lon// nyams yang skar ma sbrum la nyams// ser mo chang gi phywa khug la// ser mo chang gi g.yang skyobs shig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ sgyed po spun gsum gyi phywa dang g.yang lon pa// lon yang skar ma bra nye dag la lon// nyams yang skar ma bra nye dag la nyams// sgyed po spun gsum gyi phywa dang g.yang khug la// sgyed po spun gsum gyi g.yang skyobs shig

/khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ra ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// hūṃ/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// longs spyod rgya mtsho bzhin du me re re// ri bo bzhin du skyu ru ru// chu bo bzhin du sha ra ra// nyi zla bzhin du skor ro ro// bkra shis sna dgu'i g.yang slan cig /btsan po'i btsan yang 'dir khug cig /'phel ba'i 'phel g.yang 'dir khug cig /drag po'i drag g.yang 'dir khug cig /gsum pa mdzo dmangs kyi mdzo g.yang 'dir khug cig /gru gu g.yu dmangs kyi g.yu g.yang 'dir khug cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// mi phywa khug la phyugs g.yang skyobs// phywa khug cig /g.yang khug cig /khug las byon cig /skyobs las byon cig /ces rin po che'i ga'u kha bcad do// des g.yang khug so// de skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa dang*/ lha'i bu nor bu lha zhes pa'i bang mdzod thams cad gang bar gyur te// lha'i bu nor bu lha zhes pa'i mdo// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// g.yang slan pa'i cho ga 'di/ phyugs nad chen po byung ba dang*/ phyugs g.yang nyams sam/ god kha chen po byung ba'am/ g.yang nyams pa'am/ mngal du bu mo mang po skyes pa dang*/ sgo'i god kha chen po byung ba dang*/ mi nor zas gsum nyams pa la/ chos lugs 'di yis skyid g.yang len no// bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas lha'i don du mdzad pa'o// zhes tshe dgug bya ba ni// shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /nub phyogs chu lha'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /shar lho me lha'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /lho nub srin po'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /nub byang rlung lha'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /byang shar dbang ldan lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug

/steng phyogs tshangs pa'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /'og phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /'byung ba rnam lnga'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /bdud dang 'dre srin lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /khams gsum srid gsum lag nas bkra shis tshe g.yang khug /sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum gyi lag nas bkra shis thams cad 'dir khug cig /khu ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā// lha'i bu nor bu lha g.yang skyabs zhes bya ba gser 'od dam pa'i mdo nas nor lha sgrub thabs las le'u 'di zur khol du phyung ba yin no// bkra shis/// /
